purpose: Replace the frozen, geometry-rejected Calibration-v3 attempt with an independent 128-family population; prevent non-target candidate occlusion in INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE without changing scientific method, visibility gate, or metrics.

parent_contract.inheritance_rule: Inherit frozen B0, spatial-risk v2, unsafe definition, model input boundary, all scientific metrics and gates, camera, 4x4x8 quota, affine-logit fit, optimizer, bootstrap, threshold grid, ranking tolerances and sealed Test/robot rules verbatim. Replace only population namespace and deterministic scene geometry design needed to eliminate the six observed candidate-visibility failures. Any other change requires a separately preregistered replacement contract.

failure_diagnosis_evaluator_only.v3_requested_balance: 4 states x 4 relations x 8 repetitions = 128 families
failure_diagnosis_evaluator_only.valid_target_visible_pixel_interval: [1,120); 55-99 pixels in all six failed cases is within the frozen gate
failure_diagnosis_evaluator_only.actual_failing_conjunct: At least one non-target candidate has visible semantic-label pixels below the frozen 120-pixel minimum.
failure_diagnosis_evaluator_only.cause_scope: The v3 context-object displacement does not ensure the two non-target candidate masks remain visible; do not change the target visibility interval or silently relabel these six scenes.
failure_diagnosis_evaluator_only.allowed_use_of_failed_v3: Evaluator-side geometry failure diagnosis and exact exclusion registry only; never use v3 as calibration data, model input, training, fit, threshold selection, or scientific evaluation.

v4_population.index_rule: index = ((state_index * 4 + relation_index) * 8) + repetition, with zero-based indices
v4_population.capture_order_rule: Sort by full hexadecimal sha256('gazebo_calibration_v4_capture_order_v1|' + family_id); duplicate digest is a hard failure.
v4_population.population_selection: Generate all 128 families from this lock once, before any calibration capture or model inference. No seed selection, replacement, row deletion, reselection, or multiple-attempt mixing conditional on outcomes.

geometry_design_revision.scope: Only the layout-construction rule and pre-inference geometry-only pilot; never the pixel gate or the scientific method.
geometry_design_revision.camera_and_world: Inherit the frozen Gazebo world, fixed camera pose, camera frame, intrinsics and RGB-D geometry from v3. Do not choose a different camera viewpoint to repair a scene.
geometry_design_revision.generator_inputs: Frozen v3 scene/config geometry may be used as a template to construct NEW layouts, never to copy samples, scene/layout signatures, images, seeds, or calibration labels for fit.
geometry_design_revision.non_insufficient_states_rule: For FOUND, AMBIGUOUS and ABSENT, use the v3 geometry template for the corresponding state/relation/repetition. Translate EVERY visible object's base-link x by dx=0.0020+0.0007*(h mod 7) metres, translate base-link y by dy=-0.0030+0.0006*((h >> 3) mod 9) metres, and add yaw delta=0.0340+0.0050*((h >> 7) mod 11) radians, where h is the v4 per-family uint32 deterministic seed. Preserve each state's existing geometric definition. All new physical layout signatures must differ from every v3 signature. Do not select offsets using calibration renders.
geometry_design_revision.insufficient_evidence_rule: Preserve the visual-only occluder mechanism and target as a pair; generate two NEW non-target context placements independently of the v3 context-object displacement. Fix all candidate placement coordinates before rendering the pilot or any calibration family. Do not place a candidate at an occluder or target location or select a replacement using calibration outcomes.
geometry_design_revision.context_placement_rule: For each INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE v4 family, start from the corresponding v3 geometry template and preserve the target/visual-only occluder pair as fixed relative geometry. Map the two non-target candidate IDs in lexicographic order to the two normalized anchor centers specified above. For candidate index i in {0,1}, set u = anchor_u + 0.0040*(((h >> (8*i)) mod 5)-2) and v = anchor_v + 0.0050*(((h >> (8*i+3)) mod 5)-2), where h is the v4 per-family uint32 deterministic seed. Inverse-project (u*640,v*480) through the inherited fixed camera to the horizontal support plane z taken from the frozen v3 object config for that candidate; retain that asset's model identity and support height, and set yaw=0.0700+0.0070*((h >> (16+3*i)) mod 11) radians. The implementation must freeze exact inverse-projection math, camera transform, support-plane heights and pre-render clearance checks before producing any pilot or calibration scenes. No alternative anchor search or rendered-sample optimization is allowed.
pre_render_checks: Both non-target candidate centers are strictly within the camera image and physically supported by the locked table/workspace.
The target, occluder and non-target candidate bounding footprints are collision-free except for the intentional visual-only target occlusion.
Non-target candidates have projected centers separated from the target and occluder, from image borders and from each other under the implementation-locked clearance rule.
Target projection stays within the inherited outer margin; relation order is consistent with the annotated query.
Reject the complete generated plan before any rendering if any analytic check fails; do not silently replace a row or search for a different seed.
geometry_design_revision.post_render_qc_unchanged: For each INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE scene, target semantic mask must have 1-119 visible pixels, target projection must pass the existing near-image rule, and EACH non-target candidate semantic mask must contain at least 120 visible pixels. Other state, visibility, metric-depth, TF, uniqueness, duplicate and leakage gates remain exactly as inherited from v3.

independent_pilot.role: Development-only geometry robustness gate; never calibration fit, architecture selection or scientific scoring.
independent_pilot.balance: 4 states x 4 relations x 2 repetitions = 32; all 16 cells represented
independent_pilot.pilot_index_rule: pilot_index = ((state_index * 4 + relation_index) * 2) + repetition, with zero-based indices and repetition in {0,1}
independent_pilot.pilot_capture_order_rule: Sort by full hexadecimal sha256('gazebo_calibration_v4_geometry_pilot_capture_order_v1|' + pilot_family_id); no pilot IDs/seeds/layout signatures may be reused in calibration.
independent_pilot.generation_order: Implementation package hash-lock -> static disjointness/pre-render audit -> capture and QC pilot -> only if 32/32 geometry and all duplicate/leakage gates PASS, separately authorize 128-family calibration capture.
independent_pilot.pass_gate: One complete immutable pilot capture attempt with 32/32 post-render geometry PASS, including 8/8 INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE with every non-target candidate >=120 pixels, plus unique identifiers/seeds/layout signatures and no exact/perceptual RGB overlap.
independent_pilot.fail_rule: Freeze entire failed pilot and stop; no per-scene repairs, row substitution or parameter search within this revision. A further append-only data-design revision is required before another pilot.
independent_pilot.blindness: Do not run B0, spatial-risk v2, calibrator, threshold selection, or Test on the pilot.

exclusion_and_privacy_boundary.exclude_all_prior_and_failed_attempts: Train-UQ/Val-UQ (including all failed attempts), Dev-v2, Calibration-v1/v2, frozen Calibration-v3 attempt 01 (all 128, not merely six failures), pilot, and every previously reserved non-sensitive Test-IID/OOD exclusion identifier, if such a registry exists. Do not open sealed Test inputs or predictions. Check parent families and canonical physical layout signatures; compare captured RGB exact/perceptual duplicates after pilot/calibration capture.
exclusion_and_privacy_boundary.layout_signature_rule: Canonicalize world, fixed camera, occluder identity and shape and sorted model-name+pose xyzrpy rounded to 6 decimals; exclude annotation/ID/split fields. Require zero overlap with frozen prior signatures and between pilot/calibration.

scientific_protocol_invariants.risk_method: frozen spatial-risk v2; exact same 12 ordered features; no refit
scientific_protocol_invariants.unsafe_definition: inherit unchanged from parent v3 contract
scientific_protocol_invariants.probability_metrics: ECE-10 and Brier must both strictly decrease
scientific_protocol_invariants.calibrator: one positive-slope affine-logit fitted once to NEW 128-family Calibration-v4 only; inherit exact L-BFGS-B objective, initialization, bounds and options
scientific_protocol_invariants.operating_threshold_grid: 0.00 to 1.00 inclusive, step 0.01; inherit all operating gates and lexicographic rule
scientific_protocol_invariants.mcnemar: exact two-sided if selected threshold exists; never changes pass/fail gate

required_next_artifacts_before_any_rende: Implement exact deterministic generator/projection code bound to this lock; then generate pilot and calibration scene/config/manifests once, without rendering or inspecting model outcomes.

Freeze a separate implementation package binding this lock's SHA-256, exact generator/projection code, pilot+calibration ID/seed/layout manifests, camera/world/asset configs, and hashes of the complete prior exclusion registry.

Static audit must prove 4x4x2 pilot and 4x4x8 calibration balance, unique family/scene/layout IDs and seeds, fresh physical signatures and zero overlap with all prior splits including failed v3 while keeping sealed Test/robot untouched.
